They orbit at multiple distances — some very close and slightly overlapping the figure, others 2-3 feet further back in slightly softer focus. Connecting the orbiting cards: subtle golden light trail lines in warm amber, drawing the circular orbital path in glowing curves of light that wrap around the subject, fading in and out. The overall lighting is warm golden-hour warmth with soft shadows, shallow depth of field, and cinematic color grading with lifted warm tones.
